items.rationale: Sections 2.4.4(b) and 7.1.9 cover like-for-like renewal of the frost-fractured valve. Case 16 supports €52 gross for one valve.
Section 7.1.9 covers the hose if it had to be renewed with the fractured valve. Case 16 supports €30 gross for one hose.
Sections 7.1.7(f) and 7.1.9 cover necessary fitting-repair labour. Three hours at €95 gross total €285, consistent with Case 16.
Section 7.1.7(e) covers consumables actually used on the valve repair, but §3.6(c) excludes the contractor’s own small equipment. Allow €9 gross for a modest quantity of qualifying consumables.
Sections 7.1.9 and 7.1.11 cover one attendance by the plumber for the insured repair. Allow €65 gross, consistent with Case 16.
Sections 2.4.6 and 5.2.2 expressly cover the camera's use to locate the confirmed escape, not purchase of the equipment. Allow €55 gross for one use, below the €2,500 aggregate leak-location cap.
Sections 2.6.4 and 3.5(a) exclude outdoor frost damage unless the optional peril was agreed, which is not shown. No escaped water reached the facade, so §2.4.3 does not apply.
Section 3.5(b) excludes removal of render loosened by uninsured outdoor frost. The covered plumbing repair does not change that under §7.1.13.
Section 3.5(b) excludes renewal of base plaster on the facade affected only by uninsured outdoor frost.
Sections 3.5(d) and 7.1.10 exclude the upgrade. There is no like-for-like allowance either, because the underlying outdoor frost damage is uninsured.
Section 3.5(b) excludes preparing and re-forming the substrate where the facade damage came from uninsured outdoor frost.
Section 3.5(b) excludes the finish coats on the uninsured facade, regardless of the number of coats applied.
Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.6 exclude repainting separate, undamaged elevations for visual consistency, even if the principal facade repair were covered.
Section 3.5(b) expressly excludes priming that forms part of the repair of uninsured outdoor frost damage.
Sections 3.5(c) and 7.1.11 exclude labour attributable to the uninsured facade work. At an ordinary rate of €65 gross per hour, five hours would otherwise cost €325.
Sections 7.1.12 and 9.6 require the flat rate to price identifiable covered work. The painter's account identifies none, and any standalone administrative fee is excluded by §3.6(b).
